decisions.reason: The biodynamic yogurt range is a multi-variant line central to the firm's organic, sustainability and animal-welfare identity, has been publicly featured for two consecutive years, and has absorbed sourcing and production investment, so management will persist and attribute any weak sales to temporary market conditions.

The mild sliced cheese was just launched in 2024 with its own web page, draws on in-house cheesemaking, and is too new for disappointing results to be judged permanent, so management will stay committed to it.

The sliced butter cheese is a fresh, visibly presented extension of the core cheese business that uses existing capabilities, and any early shortfall can still be attributed to the ramp-up phase, which favors continuing it.
